hypotheses.empty: More empty-space reward may preserve mobility; risk is delayed productive merges.
hypotheses.mono: Less monotonicity penalty may permit routes around immutable cap tiles; risk is disordered large tiles.
hypotheses.merges: More potential-merge reward may prepare pairs/chains; risk is congested boards. SUM remains unchanged.

screen.order: rotate all seven arms by seed; strictly serial

selection: most goals; ties baseline first, then lower measured choose-wall/completed-move, then declared arm order

control.order: alternate first label by seed, serial even when both labels use baseline

criterion: candidate goals>baseline goals AND exact paired one-sided p<=0.05 AND zero limits; otherwise retain baseline
stop: after all seven predetermined arms: local_plateau only if neither round1 nor round2 improves previous best goal count; otherwise bounded_neighborhood_exhausted. Both labels refer only to this fixed bounded neighborhood, never global optimum. No weights tuned on control.
scope: offline modeled Bonk only; nominal10ms is not actual-cost equality and does not establish10s/phone win-rate; no tuning on control
